Subject: Committed Spend: withdrawal schedule, tax gating & operational checklist

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our mutual action plan, attached is a proposed drawdown schedule for StellarApps' annual committed spend and a short operational checklist so billing and tax teams can align. Key points: 

- Withdrawal cadence: monthly drawdowns on the 1st of each month (paper invoice issued on the 1st; payment due net 30).
- Drawdown mechanics: we will sweep from the committed prepay balance; if balance < next drawdown amount we will trigger a top-up invoice.
- VAT / tax gating: for EU/UK entities we require either (a) customer VAT registration + valid invoice details, or (b) confirmation of reverse-charge applicability with local tax contact. Without required evidence we will hold the drawdown for up to two business days and notify you.
- Invoice consolidation: we can issue a consolidated monthly invoice for all usage + committed drawdown lines if Procurement prefers (let us know).

Attached: Redwood_Withdrawal_Schedule_v1.xlsx (breaks the monthly amounts and trigger rules).

Could you confirm: PO # (if available), remit-to preference (wire vs ACH), and the name/email of the person who will supply VAT evidence for any EU/UK entities?

I’ve CC’d Laura (billing ops) and Marcus (tax lead) so we can close operational items quickly.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
